1: [![Build and Test](https://github.com/danielm5/tiffcraft/actions/workflows/workflow.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/danielm5/tiffcraft/actions/workflows/workflow.yml)

3: # TiffCraft
4: 
5: TiffCraft is a header-only C++20 library for reading uncompressed TIFF images.
6: It provides a customizable image-data export interface and requires no separate
7: library binary.
8: 
9: # Objectives
10: 
11: TiffCraft is designed based on the following principles:
12: 
13: - Permissive license: to be used in open source and proprietary software.
14: - C++ header-only: to easy integration onto existing projects.
15: - Flexible but simple API: for ease of use.
16: - Feature complete: to cover a wide variety of use cases.
17:   - TiffCraft is NOT feature complete at this time! The objective is for guiding
18:     on-going development.
19: 
20: # Usage
21: 
22: For quick access to TIFF image pixel data with individual pixels aligned to
23: word boundaries (i.e. 8 bits, 16 bits, or 32 bits), you could use code like
24: the following:
25: 
26: ```C++
27: #include <tiffcraft/TiffExporter.hpp>
28: #include <functional>
29: 
30: int main(int argc, char* argv[]) {
31:   if (argc < 2) { return 1; }
32:   TiffCraft::TiffExporterAny tiffExporter;
33:   TiffCraft::load(argv[1], std::ref(tiffExporter));
34:   auto image = tiffExporter.takeImage();
35: 
36:   // your own image processing code
37: 
38:   return 0;
39: }
40: ```
41: 
42: TiffExporterAny will decode and convert pixels to a flat-buffer (i.e.
43:  `std::vector<std::byte>`) with 1, 2, or 4 bytes per sample the source pixel
44: format. For example, an image with 2-bits per sample is exported as an 8-bit
45: image.
46: 
47: # Advanced usage
48: 
49: Users that prefer to decode and handle the image pixel data themselves, or need
50: to handle multiple frames per image, could write their own handler:
51: 
52: ```C++
53: #include <tiffcraft/TiffImage.hpp>
54: #include <iostream>
55: 
56: int main() {
57:   TiffCraft::load("image.tiff",
58:     [](const TiffCraft::TiffImage::Header& header,
59:         const TiffCraft::TiffImage::IFD& ifd,
60:         TiffCraft::TiffImage::ImageData imageData) {
61:       std::cout << "Loaded IFD with " << ifd.entries().size()
62:                 << " entries." << std::endl;
63:       std::cout << "Image data size: " << imageData.size() << std::endl;
64: 
65:       // Add your own image processing code here
66: 
67:     });
68: 
69:   return 0;
70: }
71: ```
72: 
73: # Features
74: 
75: TiffCraft supports the following features:
76: 
77: - Reading TIFF images
78:   - Read and display image metadata
79:   - Bilevel, grayscale, palette-color, and RGB images
80:     - Varying number of bits per sample
81:     - RGB images are supported only for 3-channel images (no extra samples)
82: - Compression is NOT supported yet.
83: - Writing TIFF images is NOT supported yet.
84: 
85: Advanced users could use TiffCraft for other configurations than those
86: enumerated above by writing their customizing any of the existing exporter
87: classes, or writing their own from scratch.
88: 
89: # Feedback
90: 
91: Feedback is welcomed! Please don't hesitate to reach out by opening a
92: [GitHub issue](https://github.com/danielm5/tiffcraft/issues/new/choose)
93: if you have suggestions, feature requests, or bug reports.
94: 
95: Please let me know if you find this project useful!

1: # Changelog
2: 
3: All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
4: 
5: The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
6: and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).
7: 
8: Given a version number MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, increment the:
9: 
10:     MAJOR version when you make incompatible API changes.
11:     MINOR version when you add functionality in a backward compatible manner.
12:     PATCH version when you make backward compatible bug fixes.
13: 
14: ## [0.2.0-Unreleased]
15: 
16: ### Added
17: 
18: - Code examples
19: 
20: ### Fixed
21: 
22: - ODR violations in headers: `inline` on `version()`, `readAt()`, `writeAt()`,
23:   and both `load()` overloads (`TiffImage.hpp`); the six `operator<<` overloads
24:   moved into `namespace TiffCraft` and marked `inline` (`TiffStdOut.hpp`).
25:   Note: the stream operators are no longer visible in the global namespace;
26:   they are found via ADL, which applies to all TiffCraft types.
27: - Crash/hang fixes for malformed TIFF input: ASCII entry with count 0 no
28:   longer reads out of bounds (throws `std::runtime_error`); RATIONAL/SRATIONAL
29:   entries with a zero denominator no longer divide by zero (throws
30:   `std::runtime_error`); cyclic IFD offsets are detected and rejected (throws
31:   `std::runtime_error`).
32: - `readAt()` now detects short reads and throws `std::runtime_error`, so
33:   truncated strips/tiles no longer silently yield zero-filled buffers.
34: - `takeImage()` no longer copies instead of moving; it moves the image buffer
35:   out of the exporter, leaving it empty.
36: - `TiffExporterAny` now resets its multi-IFD state per IFD; each IFD is
37:   exported and the last successfully exported image wins (previously later
38:   IFDs were silently skipped).
39: - Example `tiff_image` reads `ImageWidth`/`ImageLength` type-agnostically, so
40:   LONG-typed entries no longer throw.
41: - README quick-start snippet fixed (removed undeclared `loadParams` argument;
42:   fixed `iffExporter` typo).
43: - `Type::BYTE` entries print as integers instead of raw characters.
44: 
45: ## [0.1.0]
46: 
47: ### Added
48: 
49: - Initial TiffCraft code for loading TIFF images and exporter for bilevel,
50:   grayscale, palette-color, and RGB images. Compression is not supported.
51: - Example `tiff_exporter` program to convert TIFF images to PNG 8-bit format.
52: 
53: ### Changed
54: 
55: - Moved all headers to `include/tiffcraft`.
